# Testament of Reuben — 1
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

**1:1** A copy of the words of Reuben, the things which he charged his sons before he died, in the hundred and twenty-fifth year of his life.
**1:2** When his brothers came to visit him, he said to them: I am dying, and I go the way of my fathers.
**1:3** And Judah, and Gad, and Levi, and all his brothers were assembled there.
**1:4** And he said to them: Listen, my brothers, and give ear to Reuben your brother, the things which I command you.
**1:5** Behold, I call the God of heaven to witness against you this day, that you do not walk in the ignorance of youth and in fornication, in which I was poured out, and defiled the bed of my father Jacob.
**1:6** And I tell you that God struck me with a great plague in my loins for seven months.
**1:7** And had not my father Jacob prayed for me unto the LORD, the LORD would have destroyed me.
**1:8** I was thirty years old when I worked this evil before the LORD, and for seven months I was sick unto death.
**1:9** Wine and strong drink I drank not, and flesh entered not into my mouth, and I ate no pleasant food; but I was mourning over my sin, for it was great.
**1:10** And Jacob my father did not cease praying for me unto the LORD, for I had sinned against Bilhah, his beloved.

**2:1** And now hear me, my children, what things I saw concerning the seven spirits of deceit, when I repented.
**2:2** Seven spirits therefore are appointed against man, and they are the leaders of the works of youth.
**2:3** And seven spirits of error are given against man from Beliar:
**2:4** First, the spirit of fornication, which is seated in the nature and the senses;
**2:5** the second, the spirit of insatiability, in the belly;
**2:6** the third, the spirit of fighting, in the liver and gall.
**2:7** The fourth is the spirit of obsequiousness and trickery, that through over-eagerness he may appear comely.
**2:8** The fifth is the spirit of pride, that one may be boastful and arrogant.
**2:9** The sixth is the spirit of lying in destruction and jealousy, to practice deceits and to conceal from kindred and friends.
**2:10** The seventh is the spirit of injustice, with which are theft and acts of rapacity, that a man may fulfill the desire of his heart.

**3:1** For fornication is the mother of all evils, separating from God, and bringing near to idols;
**3:2** because it deceives the mind and understanding, and leads young men into Hades before their time.
**3:3** For many has fornication destroyed; because, though a man be old or noble, it makes him a reproach and a laughingstock with Beliar and among men.
**3:4** And I myself was nearly destroyed on account of this; and had not the prayer of my father Jacob supported me, God would have cut me off.
**3:5** For there is no understanding nor godliness in fornication; all jealousy dwells therein, and it separates from God.

**4:1** Pay no heed to the face of a woman, my children, neither associate with another man's wife, nor meddle with affairs of women.
**4:2** For had I not seen Bilhah bathing in a covered place, I would not have fallen into this great iniquity.
**4:3** For my mind, taking in the thought of the woman's nakedness, suffered me not to sleep until I had wrought the evil thing.
**4:4** For while Jacob my father was away, the evil spirit of fornication attacked me; and I went in and saw Bilhah drunk with wine and sleeping uncovered in her chamber.
**4:5** And I lay with her and committed iniquity, and I left her sleeping and went out.
**4:6** And immediately an angel of God revealed to my father what I had done, and he came and mourned over me, and touched her no more.

**5:1** Beware therefore of fornication, my children; and if you wish to be pure in mind, guard your senses from every woman.
**5:2** And command the women likewise not to associate with men, that they too may be pure in mind.
**5:3** For constant meetings, even though the ungodly deed be not wrought, are to them an irremediable disease, and to us a destruction of Beliar and an everlasting reproach.
**5:4** For in fornication there is neither understanding nor godliness, and all jealousy dwells therein, and it separates from God.
**5:5** Hear me then, my children, in the days of my death: put away from you fornication, and love truth, and let truth guard your ways.
**5:6** For a man who has fornicated has defiled himself before God, and if he is a son of the covenant he shall never be pure in his heart before the LORD.

**6:1** For these things I command you; and I say to you: Obey Levi, because he shall know the law of the LORD, and shall make atonements for all Israel until the consummation of the times, as the anointed High Priest.
**6:2** I adjure you by the God of heaven: do truth each one to his neighbor, and keep the law of the LORD and his commandments.
**6:3** For the LORD will be exalted through Levi and Judah; for the LORD has chosen them to be princes among the people.
**6:4** And there shall come upon them a blessing of the LORD from the fruit of their seed forever.
**6:5** For I know that the children of Israel will turn from their goodness, and after I had admonished them, I knew they would depart from the LORD, walking in all evil and working the abominations of the gentiles.
**6:6** For this reason you shall be carried away into captivity, and you shall receive all the plagues of Egypt, and all the evils of the Canaanites.
**6:7** And among the gentiles you shall be for a reproach and for a curse, until the LORD returns and visits you with compassion, as he promised to your fathers.

---
*End of Testament of Reuben*
